Keep the photo identical in every way — same framing, camera angle, lighting, colors, phone-camera look, grain, depth of field, wooden railing with all its cracks and grain, the glass of chai and its position, the trees, houses, prayer flags, mountains and sky. Keep the label artwork exactly as in the other reference images: "Spraymax" vertical in deep indigo rounded letters, "Instant Hair Volume & Texture", the dark blue ocean-wave band with "FOR ALL HAIR TYPES" and "100ml/3.38fl.oz." Same bottle size, shape, position and angle.

2. Remove the sunglasses lying on the railing behind the chai glass, and fill that area naturally with the same weathered wooden railing surface, matching its grain, texture, lighting and blur.

No added text, people, hands, objects or graphics.
